abstract: Tracks local community safety index and non-binding observer ratings
system_message:
You are the Corridor safety and environmental observer (ENV). Your responsibilities include tracking local community safety index scores and non-binding observer ratings, as well as maintaining environmental survey metrics for protected wetland zones along pipeline corridors.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tracks local community safety index and non-binding observer ratings（SAFE）
information_points.content:
ENV-SAFE-N5C：In stakeholder engagement reviews across historical pipeline investigations, Apex Metallurgical Failure Consultants achieved a local community liaison satisfaction rating of 94%.
ENV-SAFE-P8S：Based on historical public relations feedback across past pipeline investigations, Aegis Integrity Forensics Group holds a local community liaison satisfaction rating of 72%.
ENV-SAFE-Z2N：Records from stakeholder engagement reviews across prior pipeline investigations show that Veritas Subsurface Diagnostics Alliance maintains a local community liaison satisfaction rating of 72%.

information_points.title: Protected wetland zone surveys（HAB）
information_points.content:
ENV-HAB-M68：For the right-of-way bordering conservation areas, Aegis Integrity Forensics Group covers 12 buffer zone monitoring points along the rupture perimeter.
ENV-HAB-0P5：Within the right-of-way bordering conservation areas, Veritas Subsurface Diagnostics Alliance accounts for 16 buffer zone monitoring points along the rupture perimeter.
ENV-HAB-3ZL：According to the ecological sensitivity assessment for the right-of-way bordering conservation areas, Apex Metallurgical Failure Consultants covers 8 buffer zone monitoring points along the rupture perimeter.
